Playbook.name: SharePoint/OneDrive — Burst of Anonymous Sharing Links by a User - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One user created a burst of anonymous (anyone-with-the-link) sharing links (AnonymousLinkCreated). Triage: legitimate bulk external collaboration, or data exfiltration / a compromised account mass-sharing content out?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Mass anonymous sharing exfiltrates data to anyone with the link, bypassing access controls - a data-loss and compromise indicator.

Assets.AssetType: Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra directory

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: O365 unified audit via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: event.action, user.name, source.ip, o365.audit.Operation, o365.audit.ResultStatus, o365.audit.ObjectId, o365.audit.ModifiedProperties, o365.audit.Parameters, o365.audit.UserId. INGEST LAG 20-60 min - all queries use a 4h window and timestamp_override event.ingested at rule level.
JCB egress NAT is 94.249.88.0/24 - internal users appear from it.

Signal.Name: Burst of Anonymous Sharing Links by a Us
Signal.Details: user with a burst of AnonymousLinkCreated.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the anonymous-sharing burst is legitimate collaboration or data exfiltration.

Step.name: Anonymous-sharing burst detail
Step.Purpose: The volume, files and timing separate normal collaboration from a mass exfil / compromised-account dump.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.dataset == "o365.audit" AND event.action == "AnonymousLinkCreated" AND user.name == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS links = COUNT(*), objects = COUNT_DISTINCT(o365.audit.ObjectId), sample = VALUES(o365.audit.ObjectId) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Many links across many distinct sensitive files in minutes = exfil/compromise. A handful for a known project is normal collaboration. Note the file types/sites.

Step.name: Did a suspicious login precede the burst
Step.Purpose: Anonymous-sharing burst right after an unusual login suggests a compromised account exfiltrating.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.dataset == "o365.audit" AND user.name == "$username" AND event.action IN ("UserLoggedIn","UserLoginFailed") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS logins = COUNT(*), sources = VALUES(source.ip) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: A login from an unusual/foreign source (not the egress NAT) before the burst supports account compromise.

Node.Condition: Many anonymous links across many sensitive files, especially after an unusual login.
Node.Result: True Positive (Data Exfiltration / Compromised Account - IR)

Node.Condition: A moderate number of links for a known collaboration project by a normal user from the egress NAT.
A policy allowing anonymous links that a user is over-using without malicious intent.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-O365ANON-BURST, INV-02-O365ANON-LOGIN to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm with the user; close as benign_activity.

TruePositive.Definition: Data exfiltration or a compromised account mass-sharing.

SOCAction.Item: Revoke the anonymous links; reset the account + tokens; open IR; review shared content.
Tighten the sharing policy; educate the user; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the change/actor in the audit log.
If unexpected/unauthorised, disable the actor session and reverse the change.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reverse the change; revoke sessions/tokens for the actor and affected principals.
Review the actor's other recent audit activity.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce MFA/conditional access; tighten admin consent and privileged-role governance (PIM); alert on these operations.

QualityChecks.Check: Account for O365 ingest lag (20-60 min) - short windows miss events; this rule uses event.ingested override.
Exclude the egress NAT 94.249.88.0/24 where source is used; tune known admin/automation via exceptions.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Links revoked; account secured; shared content reviewed.
